messages.subject: Plate compactor - date change needed
messages.body:
Hi,

I have a plate compactor booked from the Kempele depot but I need to move the dates. The work on my yard got pushed back. Can you check what's available?

Thanks,
Teemu Alatalo

messages.subject: Re: Plate compactor - date change needed
messages.body:
Hi Teemu,

Got your message. I'll check the Kempele schedule for the plate compactor and get back to you with available dates.

Marko Seppälä
Branch Manager

messages.subject: Re: Plate compactor - date change needed
messages.body:
Marko,

One more thing. I received the damage assessment for booking RB-20262082 and there's a charge of 260 euros on the plate compactor. I don't think this is justified at all. The compactor had normal use marks, nothing out of the ordinary. I've been renting from you for years and this has never happened before.

I'd like to have the charge waived.

Teemu

messages.subject: Scaffold tower return
messages.body:
Hi, the 6m scaffold tower rental is finishing up. How do I arrange the return? Do I bring it to the Oulu depot or do you collect?

Mikko Rantanen

messages.subject: Booking change - hydraulic concrete breaker
messages.body:
We need to move the dates on our concrete breaker (hydraulic) booking. The project schedule shifted and the original dates no longer work. Please let us know what's available.

Regards,
Oulujoen Betonityö Oy

messages.subject: Re: Booking change - hydraulic concrete breaker
messages.body:
Thanks for letting us know. I'll look into available dates for the breaker and get back to you.

Petri Isokangas
Senior Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Booking change - hydraulic concrete breaker
messages.body:
Petri,

We have a serious issue here. We've been charged for damage to the concrete breaker, but the check-out photos taken when the machine was handed over to us clearly show the same damage was already there before our rental. We photographed it for exactly this reason.

The damage is pre-existing and has nothing to do with our use. This charge needs to be reversed. We've been renting heavy plant from Haapaharju since 2019 and have always returned equipment in proper condition. Charging us for damage that was already present when we collected the machine is not acceptable.

Please deal with this as a matter of urgency.

Oulujoen Betonityö Oy

messages.subject: Re: Booking change - hydraulic concrete breaker
messages.body:
I've noted your concern about the damage charge. I will review the check-out documentation and photos on file and come back to you.

Petri Isokangas
Senior Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Booking change - hydraulic concrete breaker
messages.body:
Petri,

Separate matter. We're looking at booking a 13-tonne excavator for an upcoming job and need to know what delivery options you have to site. Can you send over the details?

Oulujoen Betonityö Oy

messages.subject: Invoice query - scaffold tower rental
messages.body:
Hello,

We received the invoice for the 6m scaffold tower rental and have a question about the charges. Could someone take a look and get back to us?

Regards,
Kalliorakennus Niskanen Oy

messages.subject: Tower light - end of rental
messages.body:
The LED tower light (towable) is ready to come back. Can you arrange collection from our site or should we bring it to the Kempele depot?

Kurujärven Maanrakennus Oy

messages.subject: Re: Tower light - end of rental
messages.body:
Hi,

Noted. I'll check the collection schedule and let you know the options.

Outi Vähäkangas
Regional Manager

messages.subject: Re: Tower light - end of rental
messages.body:
While we're at it, we'd like to book site fencing again, same as last time. Per 50m run. Can you set that up?

Kurujärven Maanrakennus Oy

messages.subject: Re: Tower light - end of rental
messages.body:
Thanks for the request. I'll pull up the details from your previous fencing booking and check availability.

Hanna-Kaisa Louhi
Rental Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Tower light - end of rental
messages.body:
Hanna-Kaisa,

Any news on the site fencing? We need the 50m run sorted fairly soon, same setup as before.

Kurujärven Maanrakennus Oy
